Thank you for joining! **This issue will be public.** Please do not paste identifiable private listening stories, unlicensed recordings, full copyrighted lyrics, confidential data, or medical details. A fictionalized example is welcome.

### What kind of contribution?
- [ ] A human listening observation
- [ ] Counterexample / failed AI interpretation
- [ ] Research paper or dataset
- [ ] Experimental design or result
- [ ] Accessibility / usability
- [ ] Code or other

### Question / observation
What would you like us to notice, investigate, or challenge?

### What was actually available?
- [ ] Actual audio was heard by the AI
- [ ] Only song title / artist / metadata
- [ ] Transcript or lyrics
- [ ] Human description
- [ ] No AI involved
- [ ] Not applicable

### Evidence and provenance
What did you **hear directly**, what did a **person report**, what did the **model infer**, and what remains **unknown**? Timestamps and research links welcome, but no song file upload required.

### Alternative explanation / falsifier
What would make this hypothesis wrong? How could the same passage mean something different to another listener?

### Consent and rights
I have only shared information I have permission to publish. [ ] Confirmed

### If proposing an experiment
Comparator, challenger version, frozen case-selection rule, outcome measure, safety floor, cost ceiling, and whether a test actually ran:

### What should happen next?
Smallest constructive next step.
